mapper.insert: insert into question_answers ( question_id, answer_text, answer_type, primary_answer, sort_order, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{questionId}, #{answerText}, #{answerType}, #{primaryAnswer}, #{sortOrder}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, question_id, answer_text, answer_type, primary_answer, sort_order, deleted, created_at, updated_at from question_answers where question_id = #{questionId} and deleted = false order by sort_order asc, id asc
